questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Wuchereria bancrofti?
options: Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
Operculated fluke eggs in a stool wet mount.
Microfilariae in peripheral blood; collection time matters because periodicity varies by population.
Giardia cysts with four nuclei in a stool preparation.
questions.explanation: Microfilariae in peripheral blood; collection time matters because periodicity varies by population. Giemsa films or concentration; scan at lower magnification and inspect sheath/tail at higher power.
